comments: Searches keys with the specified criteria and pagination.

params.name: algorithm
comments: (Optional) The algorithm of the key to search for.

params.name: name
comments: (Optional) The name of the key to search for. Supports wildcard search using *.

params.name: numberOfResults
comments: (Optional) The number of results to return. Defaults to 25.

params.name: orderBy
comments: (Optional) The field to order the results by. Supported values: algorithm, expiration, id, insertInstant, name, type.

params.name: startRow
comments: (Optional) The offset into the total results. Defaults to 0.

params.name: type
comments: (Optional) The type of key to search for. Supported values: EC, HMAC, OKP, RSA.
